newsitem.title: USA: Indiana Energy names top officer.
newsitem.headline: Indiana Energy names top officer.

text.p: Indiana Energy Inc said Friday its directors elected Niel Ellerbrook as president and chief operating officer of Indiana Energy and president of its Indiana Gas subsidiary, effective October 1, 1997.
Ellerbrook succeeds L.A. Ferger as president of Indiana Energy and Indiana Gas. The position of chief operating officer of Indiana Energy is a new job.
Ferger will continue as chairman and chief executive officer of both companies.

Also effective Oct. 1, 1997, the Indiana Gas board elected Paul Baker as executive vice president and chief operating officer of Indiana Gas. Carl Chapman was elected president of IEI Investments, a subsidiary of Indiana Energy that will expand its focus on serving unregulated energy markets.

"These actions by the boards continue the process of management succession at our company," Ferger said in a statement. "These are steps in a series of changes that will be taking place over the next several months to provide for an orderly transition to a new management team in contemplation of my normal retirement approximately two years from now," he said.
